title: What hovered over his plane before he vanished forever?
description:
On October 21st, 1978, 20-year-old Frederick Valentich was flying a rented Cessna 182 across Bass Strait when he radioed air traffic control about a large unknown aircraft hovering above him. He described a shiny metallic object with a green light, moving at impossible speeds. His final transmission mentioned the strange craft hovering on top of him again — followed by metallic static and then total silence.

A search covering 1,000 square miles of open ocean turned up nothing. No wreckage, no oil slick, no mayday call, no body. Investigators quietly suggested disorientation or suicide, but his flight logs showed no signs of distress before the encounter. Four years later, a light aircraft engine washed ashore near the search zone, but it was never confirmed to be his.

The case file remains open in Canberra to this day. Bass Strait has never given up the plane.
